senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. מסס) [to melt, faint,] (with ב) to be tired of, loathe; (with accus.) to cast away, reject.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 8a:4">Ber. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>אין הקב״ה מוֹאֵס בתפלתו וכ׳</he> the Lord never tires of the prayer of assemblies. Sifra <cite ref="Leviticus 3">B’ḥuck. ch. III</cite>, Par. 2 <he>מואס באחרים</he> despises others (for being his betters); (<cite ref="Leviticus 3">ib.</cite> <he>מואס אחרים</he>, corr. acc.). Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Exodus 11">Mishp. 11</cite> <he>כבר מָאֲסָן וכ׳</he> their god has rejected them; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31:10">Ex. R. s. 31</cite>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31:10">Ib.</cite> <he>אמת שמָאַסְתָּ וכ׳</he> is it true that thou hast rejected thy son?; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M00013"><he>מָאוּס</he></cite>, f. <cite ref="M00014"><he>מְאוּסָה</he></cite>; pl. <he>מְאוּסִים</he>, <he>מְאוּסִין</he>; <he>מְאוּסוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 75:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXV, 9</cite> (play on <he>כמס</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:34">Deut. XXXII, 34</cite>) <he>כמוס למאוסים</he> reserved for the rejected (nations; differ. in <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 324">Sifré Deut. 324</cite>).
<cite ref="Tractate Derekh Eretz Rabbah 2">Der. Er. ch. II</cite> <he>המ׳ בעיניהם</he> those who are despised in their own eyes (think little of themselves); a. e.

senses.gloss: to be repulsive, loathsome; to be rejected. Sifra B’ḥuck. Par. 2, ch. VIII (ref. to Lev. XXVI, 44) וכי … שלא נִמְאֲסוּ ושלא נגעלו what has been left to them so that (it might be said) they were not cast away and loathed?; Yalk. Lev. 675 (corr. acc.).
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 5a">Ḥag. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>ונ׳</he> and becomes loathsome (creates aversion to his neighbor).—V. <cite ref="M01078"><he>מִיאוּס</he></cite>.
